bayts.text: Wherever I may be (ʿayth), O you who give life, my heart and my spirit visit you on my behalf, laden with glad tidings, in an instant.
My eulogy, which I have imposed upon my soul with effort, recounts your merits, which have no end.
My certainty protects me from forsaking the praises of a master (Muḥammad) through whom the Everlasting (Allah) has sufficed me against the people of injustice and error.
Upon my right hand lies the debt of a writing that has held (divine) good pleasure, in the service of my Intimate Friend, the man of Medina, bearer of right guidance.
He (Allah) pours blessing and peace upon you, through whom a handful (of sand) from your hand scattered the enemies with the throw.
There come to you from me, at every moment and every hour, good pleasure and thanksgiving, companions of love for the Living (Allah).
The Everlasting (Allah), who has favoured me with inspiration, pours blessing and peace upon you, your Family and your Companions.
The Everlasting brings you, as a mark of honour, glad tidings of my writing, even though I am far from the land of Medina.
My Lord turns towards others than me all that I do not love, through you, in the two abodes, O you who draw down protection.
The Everlasting brings me the glad tidings of the Bestower of benefit, through you, at all times, O possessor of precedence, excellence and nearness (to God).
My whole being venerates your whole being, today and tomorrow; and if my Lord wills, I shall never be seen to falter.
My whole being strengthens the bond of my love and my service, through Him (Allah) who has led to me, in an instant (ṭayy), the most excellent of spiritual stations.
I have come out, by God's grace, from whatever draws rebuke, and the rebuker turns towards the people who forsook me.
I have come out, by God's grace, from all falsehood into the Truth, and faith in God takes firm root.
The treasuries of my Lord have been opened for me, and have driven every harm towards others than me, in this world, the next and the Barzakh (the intermediate realm).
Accept thanksgiving from me, as one accepts what exalts, and through it bring glad tidings to the Chosen One (Muḥammad), O best of guides, who confers the rank of master.
I have come out of harm together with the Effacer (Al-Māḥī, Muḥammad), by (the grace of) my Lord; and whoever swells with pride does not turn towards me.
Addressing you, O best of creatures, is my felicity: it gives security to my whole being on the Day the Trumpet is blown.
You have repelled the enemies from me, and driven those who transgressed towards others than us, while each of them swelled with arrogance.
Your Servant (Khadīm) is well pleased with you: accept his thanksgiving, for the Face of Him (Allah) for love of whom he is effaced in you.
His sins have been erased from him after repentance to the Everlasting, whose servant he is, sighing humbly towards Him.
Accept this year, O Chosen One (Al-Mukhtār, Muḥammad), for (the love of) God, my service: upon you the two salutations of peace of Him (Allah) through whom I glory in you.
I have come out of what must be abandoned for God alone, and my pact of sale with Him is a pact that is never dissolved.
My going forth, by (the grace of) my Lord, together with you, took place before the year hakasash (1325 H, 1907, by the Maghrebi abjad); and the rebuker turns towards others than me, not towards me.
By (the grace of) my Lord, my going forth, together with my entering the abode, erased beforehand every past wavering.
To Him also thanksgiving, after everlasting praise, for the Chosen One (Muḥammad), the best of creatures, the favoured.
For my Lord, the Most High, I have become a servant addressing him (Muḥammad) whose excellence is manifest to anyone of intellect.
(The verse) "There has certainly come to you (a Messenger)" (Qur'an 9:128) has come to us praising you, from God, Lord of the Mighty Throne, who bestows excellence.
In the Qur'an has come what shows us your precedence, from Him (Allah) who grants the perfect gift.
You are the one to whom, from pre-eternity, Prophethood was given, while Adam was still between water and clay, about to come forth.
Each of the elect has excellence and rank; but with the Most High no servant is like the son of ʿAbd Allāh (Muḥammad).
Each of the masters has standing and sanctity; but the rank of the Chosen One (Muḥammad), the Righteous, rises above all.
If the Messengers who preceded you came with wondrous signs, they obtained them through you, from Him (Allah) who bestows grace.
To the Lord of the Throne I have surrendered my whole being, by your rank; and my provision for His Gardens is the best of the revealed (Books) (the Qur'an).
For you I have asked my Lord for His two salutations of peace, forever, together with the Family and the Companions, O best of those sent.
To my Lord, who by your rank has made the enemies yield to me, goes my thanksgiving after praise, without any wavering.
My need has turned to Him (Allah) who splits what was joined (Fātiq ar-ratq); truly I am His servant, and He has granted me emancipation.
My pens bear a debt of gratitude to Him, for my parting — without having to meet them — from the people of injustice and depravity.
The hatred of those who associate (others with God) has led to me all I hoped for; and truly I am full of gratitude for that separation.
The hearts of the aggressors have been driven towards others than us, like their bodies; and God preserves my dwelling for me.
I have sought to give thanks to God with a pure thanksgiving, addressing the best of creatures, in form and in character.
You came foremost, because the Exalted (Allah) placed you first, O our Messenger, and you attained sublimity, O you who uphold the Truth by truth.
God has sent down for you verses that have driven (every enemy) towards others, save those He has chosen for me among the creatures.
With them I have overcome the people of hatred, and they are a shield: through them the Everlasting has guarded me and raised my horizon.
Their recitation is my treasure, my standing and my strength; through them it has been granted me to be, with God, a man of truthfulness.
Through them I have drawn near to Him who revealed them, He who through them was with me; and I have pleased Him with thanksgiving, in deed and in word.
Through them my eye has been cooled and my soul made serene; through them I have reached God, He who splits and who joins.
God has fulfilled my needs through him (Muḥammad) who brought them to us; and through them I am servant and Servant (Khadīm), together with freedom.
